Chapter 190: Chapter 1 I don’t think your view on the Martial Path Evolutionary Path is comprehensive (Please subscribe)

“To command a thousand paths with a single one?”

The old man’s eyes quickly flickered with vast amounts of data.

Clearly, he was computing the feasibility of such a method.

In fact, whether it’s better to comprehend one rule or multiple rules,

there has been a near-standard answer for twenty thousand years.

It depends on oneself.

...

If you are naturally close to multiple rules, then it is naturally better to comprehend multiple rules.

If you have a higher affinity for a certain rule, then it is naturally better to focus on comprehending that rule first.

But now,

this latest response

gave the old man a different direction.

“No, that’s not right.”

“To command a thousand paths with a single one, first and foremost, this ‘single path’ must be overwhelmingly suppressive towards the ‘thousand paths’.”

“If it’s just a ‘path’ on the same level, why would it command a thousand?”

The old man deduced for a long time and hit a dead end.

“But this method is indeed possible.”

Reinvigorated, the old man ignored the data that kept appearing on the nearby screen.

“No, I have to have a good chat with this fellow.”

The old man immediately clicked on the avatar of the person who gave this response, trying to obtain their contact information directly.

“Not enough permission?”

The old man blinked his eyes.

“I’m at least a Level 8 citizen, how can I not have enough permission?” the old man muttered.

“Let’s see if I can…”

Many streams of data once again flickered through the old man’s eyes.

However, the next moment,

a solemn and cool voice came through.

“Great Scholar Tai’e, your actions violate Article 13 of the Human Alliance’s constitution. If you continue, you will receive the corresponding punishment…”

“Heh heh, Goddess of Wisdom… I was just trying to see if there were any loopholes in the information blockade set by you three goddesses, with absolutely no intention of violating the constitution…” the old man quickly explained with a chuckle.

“Great Scholar Tai’e, whether there are loopholes or not will have corresponding handling measures, it’s not your concern…” The Goddess of Wisdom’s tone remained unfluctuating.

“Alright then.”

The old man sat back down.

“By the way, Goddess of Wisdom,”

“Why is there such extensive information lockdown on the citizen who offered that response, to the extent that even I cannot inquire about their information?”

The old man paused for a while, immediately asking probingly.

It should be known that the old man was a Level 8 citizen, and also a rare Evolution Scholar, whose status could rank in the top three among dozens of surrounding star domains.

“Great Scholar Tai’e, you don’t have enough permission to know about this matter…”

The Goddess of Wisdom answered indifferently.

“Oh…”

Great Scholar Tai’e fell into contemplation.

Could it be that the other party is also a great scholar, and one of those researching top-secret achievements? Otherwise, it wouldn’t make sense for their information to be completely inaccessible.

“Forget it.”

“I’ll play it straight.”

Great Scholar Tai’e thought for a long time and realizing there was no shortcut, he left his own question under the ‘To command a thousand paths with a single one’ response.

As long as the person who gave this response logs in and enters the Founders’ World, they will see it.

…

Canglan Star.

Central Continent Manor.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

Many pieces of information about the Martial Path Evolutionary Path appeared on the screen before him.

“First Tier Chapter: 36,783 people.”

“Second Layer Chapter: 494 people.”

“Third Rank Chapter: Zero.”

Lin Yuan was looking at the number of Evolvers at each stage of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

In the Cosmic Human Alliance, Evolvers need to purchase the Evolution Path under their real names, and after becoming an Evolver, they must register with the Evolver’s Association.

If they make any breakthroughs, they also need to go to the Evolver’s Association to ‘update’ their rank information.

As a result, the Human Civilization’s official data will naturally reveal the number of Evolvers at each rank.

Of course, there will be discrepancies, like if an Evolver breaks through to the Second Layer but forgets to update their rank information because of other matters.

However, such cases are relatively rare and fall within the margin of normal error.

“To date, not a single person has cultivated to the Third Rank Chapter?”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

The Third Rank Chapter of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path already involves the shallow understanding of rules.

When Lin Yuan first created this chapter, he was in the Divine Arms World, had many Divine Weapons to contemplate, and possessed Against-Heaven’s Understanding.

For other Evolvers in the Main World, it was evident that they did not enjoy the benefits that Lin Yuan had.

Therefore, even with a complete guide such as the Martial Path Evolutionary Path that Lin Yuan had developed, stepping into the Third Rank Chapter was not going to be easy.

“I could make a tutorial video when I have the time…”

Lin Yuan secretly thought to himself.

Since spreading his own Evolutionary Path would be beneficial for his Ultimate Leap in the future, Lin Yuan naturally wanted to lower the difficulty for other Evolvers to cultivate the Martial Dao Cultivation Evolution Path.

This action would serve two purposes.

Not only would it increase the number of Evolvers on the Martial Path Evolutionary Path,

but it would also create more revenue for him. With dedicated tutorial videos, other Evolvers who were on the fence could have an epiphany and step into the realm of the Martial Dao.

“Another hundred plus people have purchased the Fifth Rank Chapter…”

Lin Yuan glanced at the sales numbers of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path and saw the number behind the Fifth Rank Chapter was one hundred twenty-six.

This meant that one hundred twenty-six people had purchased the Fifth Rank Chapter.

When uploading the Fifth Rank Chapter, Lin Yuan set the price at five hundred million.

First Tier Chapter: Ten thousand.

Second Layer Chapter: Five hundred thousand.

Third Rank Chapter: Five million.

Fourth Rank Chapter: Fifty million.

Fifth Rank Chapter: Five hundred million.

With more than a hundred copies of the Fifth Rank Chapter sold, that equated to selling over fifty billion.

Even after a split of proceeds and the deduction of related taxes, Lin Yuan would still take home over ten billion.

And this was just a few days after the upload. As time passes, the number of buyers would only increase.
